summary: The customer called to inquire about the refund status for an order they cancelled two weeks prior because the product was unavailable. The agent checked the system, confirmed the cancellation and credit card payment method, and acknowledged that the standard refund window had passed. The agent apologized for the delay, created an urgent follow-up request with the finance department, and assured the customer the funds would arrive within two days. The call ended cordially.

evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Escalate the refund request to the accounting department and ensure the funds appear in the customer's bank account within two days.

rubric_scores.justification: The agent acknowledged the customer's frustration regarding the two-week delay and offered a sincere apology.
